filesystem_isolation: task-blind provider transport plus an exact one-tool MCP surface; every operator command uses a fresh source-free, credential-free, no-network Bubblewrap namespace

grader.boundary_limitation: The trusted direct stdio shim is part of the retained-auth transport boundary and can read provider authentication by construction; the campaign proves task paths and task sockets are absent, not provider-internal noninspection. Availability and cross-family comparison claims belong to the frozen campaign policy and observed capability evidence, not this provider configuration.
grader.broker_boundary: The operator command broker receives neither provider credentials nor semantic prompts; each command executes in a fresh per-command no-network mount/PID namespace. The grader evidence tool is read-only.
grader.grader_boundary: one read-only evidence MCP tool over the frozen grade bundle; no operator command broker
grader.grader_invocation_contract: fresh ephemeral strict-config Codex exec with one read-only evidence MCP tool and exact output schema
grader.operator_boundary: one bounded terminal MCP tool backed by a credential-free, prompt-free command broker and source-free no-network command namespace
grader.operator_invocation_contract: fresh ephemeral strict-config Codex exec; exact role-specific MCP configuration; all intrinsic and optional action features disabled; combined prompt delivered through closed stdin
grader.provider_network_scope: permitted only for the provider transport used by capability probes and fresh operator/grader sessions
grader.tool_boundary: Strict per-session direct stdio MCP. The operator receives only mcp__operator__terminal (enabled as terminal); the grader receives only mcp__grader__evidence (enabled as evidence). Codex built-in and intrinsic action features are disabled.
grader.transport_boundary: Codex runs in a task-blind retained-auth transport namespace with no task paths or task sockets. A trusted direct stdio MCP shim shares that namespace and can read retained provider authentication until transport exit.
